racial.name: Every Man for Himself
racial.mechanic: Once per combat, the first time this hero is affected by hard crowd control, there is a 35% chance to immediately break that effect.
racial.balance_role: Encounter utility; valuable when hard crowd control is present.

racial.name: Treasure Finder
racial.mechanic: After a successful activity, there is a 10% chance to receive one additional roll from that activity's standard loot table. The bonus roll cannot produce access keys, progression-critical items, guaranteed first-clear rewards, or unique one-time rewards.
racial.balance_role: Progression and economy racial rather than a combat racial.

racial.name: Resourceful
racial.mechanic: Whenever this hero spends Mana, Rage, or Energy on an ability, there is a 10% chance to refund 50% of that ability's resource cost.

racial.name: Shadowmeld
racial.mechanic: Once per combat, briefly fade from enemy attention, providing a defensive avoidance window.
racial.balance_role: Avoidance and utility racial intended to reward defensive timing.

racial.name: Blood Fury
racial.mechanic: Damaging attacks and abilities have a 10% chance to grant 20% increased Attack Power for 6 seconds, with a 20-second internal cooldown.

racial.name: Cannibal Strike
racial.mechanic: This hero heals for 5% of auto-attack damage dealt. Healing occurs after the auto-attack resolves and cannot exceed maximum health.

racial.name: War Stomp
racial.mechanic: Once per combat, disrupt nearby enemies with a short control effect.
racial.balance_role: Durable control-oriented racial with situational encounter utility.

racial.name: Berserking
racial.mechanic: Auto-attacks have a 10% chance to grant 20% increased auto-attack speed for 6 seconds, with a 20-second internal cooldown.
